reviews.review:
Risk of Rain 2 is a masterfully crafted game on all accounts. Now, let me preface this review by saying that I usually don't play roguelikes. I don't know, they just usually aren't my thing. But this game... was different. I think the best way to formulate my thoughts would be to go over what I love about this game, starting with

VISUALS
The visuals in this game are beautiful and absolutely stunning. The game uses a cartoonish, cel-shaded kind of style, and my god it worked. The game is colorful and vibrant, and everything really pops. Not to mention the landscapes are beautiful as well.

GAMEPLAY
Risk of Rain 2 is a roguelike game, which means that you start with basically nothing and get items, level up, and progress through your playthrough. Dying means you lose all of this and must go again. I'm usually not the biggest fan of this gameplay style, but Risk of Rain 2 managed to encapsulate everything fun about it into one amazing title. Leveling up and getting stupid powerful will never cease to feel awesome. And, the game encourages exploration as well, which I really like! It functions on a system where, every second, the game gets *slightly* harder. This means you can either rush to the end of each level as quickly as possible, and have an easier time but not be as powerful, or take your time and explore a bit to get more powerful at the cost of the game being harder. I personally prefer the latter.

ACCESSIBILITY
At first, the game can seem technical and overwhelming, with all the characters and abilities, and levels and powers and worlds... but the game does a nice job pacing it all out to not overwhelm you so much. After your first run you should pretty much know what to do.

REPLAYABILITY
This has got to be one of my favorite parts about Risk of Rain 2. The game randomly generates each level, and even the level styles are different each playthrough. No two playthroughs are exactly alike, and it makes the core game never really feel stale.

ENEMY DESIGN
The enemies and bosses in this game are all masterfully designed. They are simple, with usually only having one or two moves, but the sheer variety and the way they all mix in combat combined with your powers make for combat that is fast-paced, frenetic, and fun.

DIFFICULTY
The game has several difficulty options. I played on Normal, and even then the game never let me get too comfortable. You're constantly on your toes while playing, and I love that.

STORY
The game has some story for those who want it, but the game is not too heavily story based. For those who just want to turn their brain off and kill, don't fret!

MULTIPLAYER
Now, I personally haven't experienced this yet, but from other accounts the multiplayer in this game is amazingly fun. Maybe if I had friends I could tell ya about it, I don't know ¯\_(ツ)_/¯

CONCLUSION
Overall, Risk of Rain 2 is an amazing game. The visuals are amazing, the gameplay loop never really gets old, and the combat is just awesome. I bought it and hopped in, thinking I'd play a couple games and stop, and the next time I had looked at the clock three and a half hours had gone by. I do think the game is priced a little high, maybe $20 or $15 would be better, but honestly I don't care too much. (If I'm being real, I got it from a steam key site for $9 anyway) If you've got the money, please, at least try it. And if you're thinking about it like I was... just take the plunge. You won't regret it :)
